jp:
「ちょっと　ちょっと　桃太郎さん！
　勝手に　入らないで　くださいよ！」
en: "Hey, hey, Momotaro-san! Please don't just barge in here!"
"Hello, Momotaro-san!"{KP}"I'm Yukiichiro, the eldest of the Snow Oni Brothers!"{KP}"Here you can enjoy the game {bb}Slippity Slide{ww}!"{KP}"Would you like to play {bb}Slippity Slide{ww}?"{KN}

jp:
「遊び方の説明を　聞きますか？」
　
　{KN}
en: "Would you like to hear how to play?"{KN}

How to Play Slippity Slide{KP}"It's a game where you race up the Ice Tower to the top floor!"{KP}"You compete for the best time to the top floor!"{KP}"There are 2 courses. The stairs on the left lead to the {bb}Teeny Course{ww}, with 30 narrow floors,"{KP}"and the stairs on the right lead to the {bb}Huge Course{ww}, with 10 wide floors!"{KP}"Along the way, there are floors that reverse your controls..."{KP}"Slippery floors! Floors where you can only move the way the arrows point..."{KP}"Floors that drop you down to the floor below..."{KP}"Floors that show directional buttons for up, down, left and right when you step on them..."{KP}"On those floors, press the yellow part of the directional button pointing where you want to go."{KP}"All kinds of ice floors are waiting for you!"{KP}"Press the Circle button to see what kind of floor you're standing on!"{KP}"Press the X button to run faster!"{KP}"Be patient, figure out the ice floors, and aim for the goal!"{KP}"Now, take on whichever mode you like!"

jp:
「そうですか…
　やる気が　わいたら
　遊びに　来てくださいね！」
en: "I see... Come and play whenever you feel up to it!"

jp:
「では　お好きな　モードに
　チャレンジして　ください！」
en: "Now, take on whichever mode you like!"
"Uhyahya...! I am the Helper Hermit!"{KP}"You seem to be in quite a fix!"{KP}"In light of all your hard work so far, I could help you out. What do you say?"{KN}

jp:
「ならば　夜叉姫から
　大切な物を　もらうがよい！」
en: "Then go and receive something precious from Yashahime!"

jp:
「もう　桃太郎さん！
　ずっと上で　待ってたのに！」
　{KP}
「仕方ないわね！
　はい　これが
　{bb}氷の篠笛（しのぶえ）{ww}よ！」
en: "Honestly, Momotaro-san! I was waiting way up there the whole time!"{KP}"Oh well! Here, this is the {bb}Ice Flute{ww}!"

jp:
「せっかくだから
　また　いっしょに
　旅が　したいわ！」{KP}
　
「{bb}ほほえみの村{ww}で
　そろそろ　{bb}だじゃれ大会{ww}が
　始まるころよね！」{KP}
　
「{bb}ほほえみの村{ww}まで
　いっしょに
　行きましょう！」
en: "Since we're together again, I'd love to travel with you some more!"{KP}"The {bb}Pun Contest{ww} in {bb}Hohoemi Village{ww} should be starting about now!"{KP}"Let's go to {bb}Hohoemi Village{ww} together!"

jp:
「よしよし！　負けん気の　強い
　男ぢゃの！　ウヒャヒャ…！」
　{KP}
「無理せずに　がんばることぢゃ！
　ウヒャヒャ…！」
　{KP}
「もう一度　チャレンジぢゃな！」
en: "Good, good! You're a lad who hates to lose! Uhyahya...!"{KP}"Do your best, but don't push yourself! Uhyahya...!"{KP}"Time for another try, eh!"
